{{Quote|Cody, get the tanks down. Come in, Cody!|Jet, trying to contact Commander Cody during the Second Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
'''Jet''', designated '''CC-1993''', was a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] who served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Jet and Mundi were part of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] sent to [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|reconquer]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle of the war]] and [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. The main aim of Jet and the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]]&mdash;which also consisted of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], as well as their respective [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone forces]]&mdash;was to destroy the planet's [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factories]], which included the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]] maintained by [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]]. After departing from their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], Jet, Mundi, and their forces met heavy resistance from the Geonosian defensive [[Flak/Legends|flak]].

In a short [[Time/Legends|time]], the Republic force was decimated, and the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] carrying Jet and Mundi crashed. After the crash, Mundi decided to make their way to the staging area by going through a cave and to later rendezvous with Kenobi at the Republic [[Point Rain/Legends|staging area]]. Although Jet, Mundi, and their troops encountered fierce resistance by winged [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|Geonosian warriors]] in the cave, they were able to get through to the other side, where they met Skywalker's forces. Jet, the Jedi, and the combined [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces then proceeded toward the staging area and, with [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|bomber]] support, helped Kenobi and his forces defeat the enemy troops. Afterward, Jet and the Republic forces attacked the enemy [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], destroying it and securing the way to Poggle's primary [[Droid/Legends|droid]] foundry.

==Biography==
===Landing at Point Rain===
{{Quote|What are our losses, Captain?''"<br />"''We got hit pretty hard. I think only Kenobi's forces made it through the flak to the landing zone.|Jet, informing Ki-Adi-Mundi of the situation after the crash landing|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
[[File:ClonecommandersGeonosis-LaPT.png|thumb|left|300px|Rex, Cody and Jet met with the Jedi to discuss battle strategies.]]
Jet, designated CC-1993,<ref name="CE" /> was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] created<ref name="clones" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="CE" /> to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="LaPR" /> Sometime during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was assigned to the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]<ref name="CE" /> and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Council]] member<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|kiadimundi|Ki-Adi-Mundi}}</ref> [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]].<ref name="CE" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle of the war]] and [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], once more became a threat to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] as Geonosis [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] rebuilt [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid factories]] on the planet. Jet and Mundi were part of an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]], together with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], sent to [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|reconquer]] the planet.<ref name="LaPR" />

Jet and Mundi spent [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] studying [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] reports about the planet's defenses and discussed strategies to invade the planet. Since the Cerean had been captured during the opening battle of the war on Geonosis, he wanted to make sure that the defenses of the Geonosians would not be underestimated again.<ref name="CE" /> Aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]<ref name="CWA: Geonosis Saga">{{TCWA|Geonosis Saga}}</ref> in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Geonosis, Jet; Mundi; Skywalker; Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; and fellow clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] met to discuss the overall Republic strategy for an attack on the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] protecting Poggle's [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]]. Jet and Mundi would attack from the north, while Kenobi and Cody would attack the center and Skywalker would lead the southern assault. The Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were scheduled to rendezvous at a staging area<ref name="LaPR" /> called "[[Point Rain/Legends|Point Rain]]"<ref name="CWA: Geonosis Saga" /> near the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator and establish a defensive perimeter there. After the briefing, Jet and Mundi departed to their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]],<ref name="LaPR" /> the [[Separatist Nightmare/Legends|''Separatist Nightmare'']].<ref name="Landing at Point Rain Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

[[File:SecondGeonosis-Scale.jpg|thumb|right|275px|The Republic deployed many gunships to the surface.]]
Descending through Geonosis's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], the Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] released groups of LAAT/i [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT carriers]], with Jet and Mundi's gunship being in the last group to depart from the ''Resolute''. The Republic landing forces met heavy resistance from enemy [[Flak/Legends|flak]] and [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Geonosian fighters]]. On Mundi's orders, Jet contacted Cody and told the [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] to land his [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]], which were being held aboard Kenobi's [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] gunship. Shortly afterward, the gunship containing Jet and Mundi was shot down and crashed to the ground. After being helped out of the destroyed gunship, the injured Mundi asked Jet for a status report. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]] reported that Kenobi was the only one to reach the staging area and told the General that Skywalker had also been shot down and had already engaged Geonosian forces on the ground, intending to reach the staging zone and Kenobi. After Mundi ordered Jet to load the wounded [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] into the AT-TE [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], the Jedi decided that the troops would make their way toward a nearby ridge, which was located by the staging area.<ref name="LaPR" />

===Traveling across Geonosis===
{{Quote|Negative, Captain. We will be unable to provide any air support at this time.''"<br />"''I understand that, sir, but we have three attack forces on the ground and only one at the landing zone.|Jet, trying to get support from Admiral Yularen|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
[[File:Jet2-LAPR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jet communicates with Admiral Yularen via comlink during the Second Battle of Geonosis.]]
Jet's troops, including several of the remaining AT-TE tanks, advanced through<ref name="LaPR" /> a [[Caltrop field/Legends|caltrop field]]<ref name="Landing at Point Rain Ep Guide" /> en route to the ridge. Sitting in the back of an AT-TE tank, Jet contacted Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to ask for air support. However, Yularen made it clear that the only thing he could do was give them the coordinates of Skywalker's position. Heading toward Skywalker, who was en route to Point Rain, Jet, Mundi, and their troops arrived at the bottom of the ridge. Since the AT-TEs were unable to climb the ridge, Jet left some troops to protect the tanks and ordered the forces to take the longer way around the ridge to the landing zone.<ref name="LaPR" />

The commander himself accompanied Mundi and the rest of the troops to a cave at the top of the ridge, which was a shortcut to the landing zone on the other side. Shortly after entering the cave, Jet and Mundi encountered [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|Geonosian warriors]] and suffered casualties. However, the clones were able to fight their way through the enemy troops, using [[BT X-42 flamethrower|flamethrowers]] to dispatch the Geonosian warriors. Reaching the end of the cave, Mundi and Jet found Skywalker and his forces at the bottom of the ridge, as well as Kenobi's forces in the distant landing zone.<ref name="LaPR" />

===Rescuing Kenobi's forces===
{{Dialogue|Special ops clone trooper|All units are in position, sir.|Mundi|Tell Skywalker to start the attack on a droid foundry.|Jet|Begin the attack.|attr=A Special ops clone trooper, Ki-Adi-Mundi and Commander Jet before Skywalker's troops began their assault on the Geonosis ray shield generator|src=<ref name="LaPR" />}}
[[File:SecondGeonosis.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jet, Skywalker, Mundi, Rex, and Tano rescue Kenobi and his troops.]]
Joining forces with Skywalker, Jet and Mundi raced to aid Kenobi's surrounded and outnumbered [[Army/Legends|army]]. Yularen was finally able to deploy a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]<ref name="LaPR" /> of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]<ref name="vehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> to aid the hard-pressed [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground forces]]. Together with the air support, Jet and the Republic forces reached the staging area and forced the Separatist line back. After finding Kenobi&mdash;who had been injured after his gunship crashed&mdash;the Jedi and their clone troopers convened for a short briefing on the situation and concluded that Skywalker would lead a small task force to disable the Geonosian [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] protecting the shield generator.<ref name="LaPR" />

[[File:Foundry_destroyed.png|thumb|left|250px|The destruction of Poggle the Lesser's primary droid foundry helped the Republic win the battle.]]
Afterward, the tanks would advance and destroy the [[Geonosis ray shield generator/Legends|generator]]. The plan worked, and Jet informed Mundi of the success as soon as Skywalker and his group deactivated the cannons. After Mundi ordered the tanks to attack, the shield generator was destroyed by the concentrated fire of the tanks. Jet and Mundi traveled by gunship to the generator as soon as it went down, where they helped Skywalker's group capture Geonosian warriors.<ref name="LaPR" /> The main [[Droid/Legends|droid]] factory<ref name="TCWWeaponsF">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref> and many other foundries were destroyed, and the Republic eventually won the Second Battle of Geonosis.<ref name="TCWLegacyofT">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>

While on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Jet sent a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] on an assignment to eliminate a Geonosian [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]] that had infiltrated and decimated the interior of a [[Unidentified Venator-class Star Destroyer (super tank)|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="CWA: War Room">{{TCWA|loc=War Room}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|General, I left a squad to protect the tanks.|Jet, to Ki-Adi-Mundi|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] clone of Jango Fett, Jet stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall (6 [[Foot/Legends|ft]])<ref name="CE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> On Geonosis, Jet knew that the plan to destroy the shield generator would result in a tough fight. However, he acknowledged that such was the life of a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]].<ref name="CE" /> During the battle, Jet gave Mundi a report about the status of the mission, mentioning all necessary facts. He obeyed the orders given to him by Mundi and understood Admiral Yularen's argumentation of why air support was limited.<ref name="LaPR" />

==Skills and abilities==
Jet was trained in combat, recon, and military tactics, as well as in handling heavy [[weapon]]s.<ref name="CE" />  Before the Second Battle of Geonosis, Jet and Mundi worked for hours to ensure that they were prepared for anything during the mission.<ref name="LaPR" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|We're almost through. Bring in the flamethrowers.|Mundi to Jet's troopers as they pushed through the Geonosian warriors|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
The clone commander used a pair of [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 blaster pistols]] in combat on Geonosis. Jet and his unit were known for bold [[Color/Legends|colors]] on their [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]], and the commander himself wore a distinctive orange-colored set of<ref name="CE" /> heat-resistant<ref name="SWTCWM4">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine 4|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars Magazine'' 4]]</ref> [[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|special ops clone trooper]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="LaPR" /> His helmet was equipped with experimental [[Comm unit/Legends|communications gear]], and he wore a [[Kama/Legends|''kama'']] that was also treated to withstand enormous [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]].<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DeeBradleyBaker.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jet was voiced by Dee Bradley Baker (pictured).]]
Jet first appeared in "[[Landing at Point Rain]],"<ref name="LaPR" /> the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which premiered on [[November 4]], [[2009]]. In the episode, he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]],<ref name="Landing at Point Rain Ep Guide" /> who voiced all clone troopers in the series.<ref name="Baker">{{SW|url=news/dee-bradley-baker-the-bad-batch-season-3-interview|text=Dee Bradley Baker Looks Ahead to the Final Season of ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch''}}</ref> In [[2010]], Jet received the designation number "CC-1993" in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="CE" />

In the episode, Jet was referred to as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] three times, conflicting with the episode's accompanying [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Landing at Point Rain Ep Guide" /> as well as other sources, which identify him as a commander, including the episode itself where Jet identifies himself as a commander.<ref name="CE" /><ref name="LaPR" /><ref name="TCW: New Battlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref><ref name="TCW Official Episode Guide Series">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> This article assumes the identification as a commander to be his correct [[Military rank/Legends|rank]].
